title: Cherrypicking with Multi-Channel Pipette and CSV - Part 2
author: Opentrons
materials: Target cell is dispensed into 384 well-plate.

steps.title: Upload and validate CSV file
steps.instruction: Upload the .csv file that follows the provided template, ensuring no commas inside well entries, using the format well_left/well_right (e.g., A1/B2), placing a 0 for missing effector or target cells, and an lowercase “x” for wells to be skipped; set the mount to either “left” or “right” and start the pre‑mix field with “Yes” or “No”.

steps.title: Determine tips for 8‑channel pipette
steps.instruction: Parse the uploaded .csv to identify which wells require liquid handling and calculate the number of tips to pick up with the 8‑channel pipette based on the parsed well list.

steps.title: Pick up required tips
steps.instruction: Using the 8‑channel pipette, pick up the calculated set of tips; keep this single tip set for the entire run (do not change tips between transfers).

steps.title: Aspirate source cell with optional pre‑mix
steps.instruction: For each source well indicated in the CSV, optionally pre‑mix the reservoir at the specified pre‑mix height if the pre‑mix field begins with “Yes”, then aspirate the user‑specified Transfer Volume Target Cell (in µL) from the reservoir well.

steps.title: Multi‑dispense into 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Dispense the aspirated volume into the 384‑well plate wells listed to the right of the slash in the CSV, using multi‑dispensing: continue dispensing to as many destination wells as the pipette tip can accommodate before returning to the reservoir for another aspiration.

steps.title: Add control cells to plate
steps.instruction: If the CSV indicates control entries, dispense the appropriate control cell volume into the designated 384‑well plate wells as specified.
